title: 和朋友商量计划：时间、地点与折中方案
subtitle: Organise a group plan without translating every word

audio.title: Organising a group project
audio.note: 断档补课。使用 00:00–01:20（80秒）。2026-11-19 已从官方页面定位媒体并按实时速度连续解码核验；完整音频约 01:49.64。页面提供完整 Transcript。先盲听后核对。

sections.title: 1｜无字幕先听：三个人怎样找到共同时间（5分钟）
sections.body: 打开官方页面，播放 00:00–01:20。第一遍不看 Transcript，只判断他们在计划什么、为什么早上十点前不合适。第二遍写下你听到的日期、时间和地点。第三遍才看原文，核对谁能在几点参加。
questions: 1. 他们为什么想先见面一小时？
2. 三个人最后同意的大致时间是什么？为什么早上方案不行？
sections.answers:
1. 为了先计划小组项目要做什么，并尽早开始。
2. 他们同意周三下午四点；有人早上十点前在睡觉，另有人周三上午没空。

sections.title: 2｜精听辨音、连读与跟读（4分钟）
sections.body:
每处盲听2遍，看文字后模仿3遍，最后关文本重听。

① “Do you want to start?”：do you 常连成 /dʒə/；want to 可弱化为接近 /wɒnə/。
② “How about we meet?”：how about 中辅音与元音自然连接，about 弱读，meet 重读。
③ “When are you free?”：when‿are 连读；free 是信息重点。

最后用原速跟读“提出时间—表示不行—给出替代时间”的部分。不要翻译每个词，只跟随时间线。
sections.answers: 辨音自查：先抓 start / morning / Wednesday / four o'clock / meet 等信息词，再补功能词。

sections.title: 3｜阅读：安排周末游戏之夜（4分钟）
sections.body: After discovering that they all enjoyed co-op games, Mia, Ben and Lucas decided to organise a game night. Mia suggested Friday evening, but Ben had to work late. Lucas was free on Saturday afternoon, while Mia had a family lunch until three. Instead of cancelling, they compared their schedules and chose Saturday at four. They first considered playing at Lucas's flat, but his internet connection was unreliable. Ben suggested a gaming café near the metro station. It was easy to reach, and they could talk without disturbing anyone. Mia booked three computers for two hours and shared the address in their group chat. Before the day ended, each person confirmed the time, place and game. The plan worked because nobody simply said “I can't.” Each person explained the problem and offered another option.
questions: 1. Why didn't they meet at Lucas's flat?
sections.translation: 米娅、本和卢卡斯发现彼此都喜欢合作游戏后，决定组织一次游戏之夜。米娅建议周五晚上，但本要加班。卢卡斯周六下午有空，而米娅要参加家庭午餐到三点。他们没有取消，而是比较日程，选定周六四点。他们起初考虑去卢卡斯家，但他家的网络不稳定。本建议去地铁站附近的电竞咖啡馆，交通方便，也可以聊天而不打扰别人。米娅预订了三台电脑两小时，并在群聊中分享地址。当天结束前，每个人都确认了时间、地点和游戏。计划成功，是因为没有人只说“我不行”；每个人都解释原因并提出另一个方案。
sections.answers:
1. His internet connection was unreliable.
2. Everyone explained their problem and suggested another option.

sections.title: 4｜词汇与高频词块（4分钟）
sections.body:
1. Do you want to start ...?｜你想开始……吗？｜Do you want to start this weekend? 你想这周末开始吗？
2. have enough time｜有足够时间｜Let's start early so we have enough time. 我们早点开始，好有足够时间。
3. How about we meet ...?｜我们……见面怎么样？｜How about we meet after work? 下班后见怎么样？
4. When are you free?｜你什么时候有空？｜When are you free on Saturday? 你周六什么时候有空？
5. ... works for me.｜……我可以｜Four o'clock works for me. 四点我可以。
6. I can't do ...｜我……没空｜I can't do Friday evening. 我周五晚上没空。
7. Where shall we meet?｜我们在哪里见？｜Where shall we meet before the film? 看电影前在哪里见？
8. Good idea.｜好主意。｜A café near the station? Good idea. 车站附近的咖啡馆？好主意。
9. unreliable｜不可靠的｜The Wi-Fi is unreliable here. 这里的无线网络不稳定。
10. option｜选择、方案｜Saturday is our best option. 周六是我们最好的选择。
sections.answers: 优先整块记住前8项，并替换日期、时间和地点快速造句。

sections.title: 5｜语法：How about + 句子/动词-ing（2分钟）
sections.body:
提出建议可说 How about we + 动词原形...?；也可说 How about + 动词-ing...?

例句1：How about we meet at four? 我们四点见怎么样？
例句2：How about meeting at the café? 在咖啡馆见怎么样？
questions: 2. 用 we 改写：How about meeting near the station?
sections.answers:
1. playing
2. How about we meet near the station?

sections.title: 6｜双人对话、替换与快速回应（4分钟）
sections.body:
【原创对话】
A: Do you want to play together this weekend?
B: Sure. When are you free?
A: How about Friday evening?
B: I can't do Friday. Saturday afternoon works for me.
A: Great. Where shall we meet?
B: How about the gaming café near the station?
A: Good idea. Let's meet at four.

【替换练习】
1. play / Friday evening 换成 watch a film / Sunday afternoon。
2. gaming café / four 换成 shopping centre / three thirty。

【快速回应：3秒内开口】
1. 对方提议你没空的时间 → I can't do Friday. How about Saturday?
2. 对方问时间 → Four o'clock works for me.
3. 对方问地点 → How about the café near the station?

【30–60秒口头任务】邀请朋友周末活动；给出一个时间；听到拒绝后提出替代；商量地点；最后确认完整安排。
sections.answers: 示例：Do you want to play together this weekend? I can't do Friday, so how about Saturday at four? Let's meet at the gaming café near the station. Great, see you then.

sections.title: 7｜复习前次词块与反馈（1分钟）
sections.body:
复习10月26日3个词块：
1. be into ...｜很喜欢……
2. play with friends｜和朋友一起玩
3. Do you want to ... sometime?｜要不要找时间……？

串联：I'm into co-op games and I usually play with friends. Do you want to play sometime?

请回原聊天告诉我：第一遍听懂比例、最卡的一句，以及你的30–60秒安排计划。只有实际收到并能分析语音时，我才评价发音。
sections.answers: 示例意思：我很喜欢合作游戏，通常和朋友一起玩。要不要找时间一起玩？
